topic: The real event so horrifying Hollywood refused to film it for 40 years
hook: Hollywood refused to make this film for 40 years. It was too real.
script: Hollywood refused to make this film for 40 years. It was too real. The Rwandan genocide of 1994 killed 800,000 people in 100 days. No major studio touched it for a decade. When Hotel Rwanda was finally made in 2004, it became the first wide-release film about the massacre. The actual events depicted were considered too disturbing for mainstream audiences. It was nominated for three Academy Awards. History waited 10 years for its film. Follow for real events too powerful for Hollywood to face.
